projects.campaign_name: Smart & Safe Florida - Adult Personal Use of Marijuana (2028 effort)
projects.purpose: Constitutional amendment to legalize adult personal use of marijuana
projects.sponsor: Smart & Safe Florida (political committee, funded by Trulieve)
projects.circulation_firm: unknown (prosecutors said they would subpoena Smart & Safe Florida's contractors and subcontractors for the 2026 effort; firms not named in sources)
projects.signatures_required: roughly 880,000 (Cannabis Business Times, Oct 5 2026); 2026-cycle figure was 880,062
projects.deadline: unknown for 2028 cycle (Feb 1 of election year under prior law; verify with FL DOS)
projects.signatures_collected: unknown for 2028; committee must start over
projects.budget_or_spend: Trulieve gave $19.6M in Q1 2025 to the committee for the 2026 effort; committee spent ~$19.47M in Q1 2025, much of it on gathering/submitting signatures. 2028 spend unknown.
projects.evidence_note: 2026 effort failed to make ballot (state said no citizen initiatives qualified, Feb 2026). Oct 5 2026 article says the committee is active for 2028 and must restart signature collection. The 2026 effort used registered paid circulators (Jan 2026 statewide prosecutor letter identified ~50 registered circulators under investigation). No 2028 job ads or firm contracts found.
